en.title: Offline Scoring and Cache Sync
en.excerpt: How Archeris ensures uninterrupted scoring during field network outages using IndexedDB local storage and background sync.
en.content:
The Offline-First Architecture

Outdoor archery venues frequently suffer from spotty cellular coverage. Archeris implements a progressive offline architecture using browser IndexedDB storage. All scoring calculations, keypad validations, and end totals execute locally on the device hardware.

Offline Visual Status Indicators

When internet connectivity drops, scorekeepers can continue recording scores without interruption:

  • The status dot changes from Green (Live) to Amber (Offline Mode).
  • A counter displays pending unsynced ends (e.g., "3 ends cached locally").

Background Queue & Sync Mechanism

As soon as cellular data or Wi-Fi connectivity is re-established, the browser automatically flushes its queue, syncing all recorded ends to the central database without user intervention.

Recommendations for Outdoor Ranges

Open the scorekeeper portal while connected to Wi-Fi or strong cellular data during morning equipment inspections to preload the offline service worker into the device cache.
